# YUMPU

> YUMPU is a global digital publishing platform that transforms PDFs into interactive flipbooks, magazines, and catalogs with SEO optimization, mobile apps, and content distribution capabilities.

YUMPU serves publishers worldwide with support for 20+ languages including English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Scandinavian, and Eastern European markets. The platform enables users to convert static PDFs into engaging digital publications with interactive features, mobile optimization, and analytics.

## Key Topics

- Digital Publishing
- PDF Conversion
- Flipbook Software
- Magazine Publishing
- Interactive Content
- Mobile Apps (iOS/Android)
- SEO Optimization
- QR Codes
- Drag & Drop Editor
- Content Distribution
- Kiosk Solutions
- Catalog Creation
- App Publishing
- YUMPU Publishing
- Pricing Plans
